name: Dalarö to Gålö Havsbad
description: Weekend paddle from Dalarö Kajak to Gålö Havsbad with accommodation/camping service node.

publicTransport: Bus/car to Dalarö or Gålö depending variant
launchNotes: Dalarö Kajak rental; Gålö Havsbad rental may support local variants.

safety.exposure: Sheltered compared with outer archipelago but exposed gaps and boat traffic exist.
seasonalNotes: Gålö bird-protection and reserve rules apply.

campingRules: Gålö reserve forbids landing near listed bird islands and within 100 m Apr 1-Jul 31; fires only designated; camping max 2 consecutive days unless designated. Verify current rules.

protectionRules.summary: Gålö reserve has updated marine protection context; use established launches/visitor areas and verify current bird/marine restrictions before routing close to shallow bays or islets.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Use established visitor/launch areas where possible.
